check_customer_history.description: Pull the customer history behind an order: account age, recent refund count, total refunded, and any risk flags.

check_refund_policy.description: Check whether an order qualifies for an automatic refund, based on how long ago it was delivered and how much it cost.

check_warehouse_stock.description: Check stock levels for a product across all warehouses. Returns quantity, restock date, and shelf location per warehouse.

close_ticket.description: Close the support ticket. Call this once the customer issue is fully resolved. This ends the conversation.

find_order.description: Look up a customer order by its order ID. Returns the item, amount, days since delivery, and current status.

finish_inventory_check.description: Finish the inventory check and report back. Call this once you have verified stock across all warehouses.

finish_risk_review.description: Finish the fraud risk review and report the verdict back. Call this once the Advocate has had their say.

issue_refund.description: Issue a refund for an order. Only call this after check_refund_policy has confirmed the refund is allowed.

customer_advocate.description: Argues the customer side against a risk verdict

order_support.description: Handle customer order and refund requests

risk_analyst.description: Assesses fraud risk on an order

fraud_review_agent.description: Assess fraud risk on an order before refunding it. A risk analyst and a customer advocate debate, and return a verdict.

inventory_check_agent.description: Check warehouse stock for a product SKU across all locations, with a second AI verifying the result.
